english: Nearby there's a Polial\nthat can take us to where Mother is.
It's where [CLAUDE] and I\nmet, desuu.
This place was that important?
This is where we\nfirst met, right?
If Noel weren't so directionally challenged,\nthis might never have happened, desuu.
At the time, I was unconsciously\nheading there, it seems.
By the way, isn't that place\nheavily guarded by enemies?
Yes, most likely.
We'll just have to break through, right?
Naturally.\nWill those mass-produced units come in droves?
A war of numbers would be rough.
Just beat 'em and beat 'em and beat 'em!
Just whack 'em, whack 'em, smash 'em!
Eye beams! Beams! More beams, nyo!
Save that energy for later.
Right. We'll end up fighting\nmore than we want anyway!
Whoa, there's a crowd!\nNow this is a sight!
A-awawah…! Everyone's matching,\nand there are so many of you…!
I'll punch holes through every last one of 'em!
I'll show you real twin blades and twin guns!
My twin blades and twin cannons too!
Rinrin's just carrying cannons on her back!
Don't call me Rinrin! I'm not a panda!
Let's finish them cleanly, no loose ends!
We're definitely coming back here,\nso of course!
We are the guardians charged with protecting humanity!\nWe leave no worries behind us!
The fake army showed up, nyo!!
Did Mother make\nthe dark army too?
She made Mie and Key, so\nshe could probably manage that…
This is tricky.\nThe enemy's tactics are getting hard to read.
Everyone, re-check your coordination!\nDon't get isolated!
More of them!
Human-wave tactics, huh…!
But sending forces out piecemeal is foolish!\nNothing we can't break through, I wonder! I wonder!
I can still fight! How about you, Satoko?
I'm fine as well!
Shirayuki, how drained are you?
I'm fine! A Hoshitogi shrine maiden isn't soft!
Houki!
Match me, Hibiki!
Natchan!
…No problem. Reki?
I can go.
Ooh, everyone's got great teamwork!
Yes! So many friends…\nHow reassuring!
There's not a single reason we'll lose!
(J, the path I chose wasn't wrong.\nWith these friends, surely…!)
(Yes, we'll surely reach a good future.)
We did it, desuu!
No matter how many come, we won't lose!
Let's hurry to the Polial!\nIf we're going, it's now!
This is it - from here we can get to Mother!
Coming face to face with the truth of the world, desuu.\nI can't help thinking about\nwhat it'd be like if Sensei were alive, desuu.
Face to face with the truth of the world, huh.\nSensei would've wanted to go…
Let's do our best for Eve's sake too.
Yes, desuu!
Of course!
Sis…?
If we go to where Mother is,\nwe might never come back.
I'll never see Father again…
Father…
(…Sis)
Tesla, it's okay!\nWe'll definitely make it back!
Yes. As long as everyone's together…\nstrangely, I'm not afraid.
Throw away those bad feelings!
…Right, you're right!
…I'll do my best.
All right! Everyone ready? We're going in!
Let's go!
